item.title: ⏱️ Waiting in wings is what matters most in assault When the entire group's advance is at stake,
item.description: Waiting in wings is what matters most in assault ⏱️ When the entire group's advance is at stake, it is necessary to act wisely. During the liberation of Mirovka , the servicemen had to perform a ruse: ‘We moved in groups of three, the distance was great. Enemy drones were working along the way, somewhere we had to spend the night in forest belts. We reached assigned positions. There were two small strongholds. As soon as night was coming, we mopped up and established control over them, so that other Russian assaultmen could advance.’ ▫️ As a result of cohesive actions, the assault detachments established control over a powerful defensive area more than 10 square kilometres, including Mirovka itself. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ 270 Russian servicemen returned from Kiev regime's territory In exchange, 270 AFU prisoners of war were transferred.
item.description: ❗️ 270 Russian servicemen returned from Kiev regime's territory In exchange, 270 AFU prisoners of war were transferred. 🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 17-23 October 2026
Part 2 (

)
🚩
During the week, the Tsentr Group's units have liberated Dobropolye, Pervomayskoye, and Sergeyevka (Donetsk People's Republic) as a result of active actions.
💥
Strikes have been delivered at
formations of five mechanised brigades, one assault brigade, one jaeger brigade, one air assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, five national guard brigades, and the Azov Special Operations Brigade.
▪️
In total, more than 2,405 troops, 44 armoured fighting vehicles, 53 motor vehicles, 16 field artillery guns, and 15 electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
🚩
Over the past week, the Vostok Group's units have continued to advance to the depths of the enemy's defence and, as a result of decisive actions, have liberated Omelnik, Timoshevka, Chervony Yar and Mirovka (Zaporozhye region) and established control over the settlement of Velikomikhaylovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
💥
Strikes were delivered at
manpower and hardware
of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, three air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade. The enemy losses in this direction amounted to more than 1,380 troops, 22 armoured fighting vehicles, 38 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
🚩
Last week, the Dnepr Group's units improved the tactical situation and liberated Malokaterinovka and Yulyevka (Zaporozhye region).
💥
Russian elements have inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade.
▪️
Up to 215 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 127 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and eight electronic warfare stations have been neutralised.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
five guided aerial bombs, three U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles, seven Flamingo long-range cruise missiles, and 5,593 fixed-wing UAVs.
⚓️
The Black Sea Fleet eliminated
five uncrewed surface vehicles of the Ukrainian Navy
in the Black Sea waters.
📊
In total, since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost:

674
aircraft,

284

▫️
268,828
unmanned aerial vehicles,

672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,363
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,792
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,794
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
75,380
support military wheeled vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ From 17 to 23 October, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out three massive and 11 group strikes,

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30234

❗️
From 17 to 23 October, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
carried out three massive and 11 group strikes,
which hit enterprises of the defence industry, logistics centres, power and transport infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, medium- and long-range UAV manufacturing workshops and depots, military hardware depots, and temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries.
💥
In addition, the Ukrainian ports' infrastructure facilities, which were used to provide reception, storing and distribution of military cargo,
have been disabled.
💥
During the week,
14 dry cargo ships and container ships supplying weapons, military hardware, and dual-use cargo to the Armed Forces of Ukraine were hit.
▫️
The Sever Group's units have completed neutralisation of the encircled enemy
in the north-eastern part of Kharkov region and continue to eliminate the enemy's solo groups.
📍
During the week, units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades, two assault brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, two territorial defence brigades, and one border detachment of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine have been hit.
▪️
Over the past week, in the Sever Group's area of responsibility, the enemy has lost more than 1,505 troops, seven armoured fighting vehicles, 124 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and 10 electronic warfare stations.
🚩
Over the past week, the Zapad Group's units have taken more advantageous positions and, as a result of decisive actions, have established control over the settlements of Palamarevka and Kovalevka (Kharkov region).
💥
Strikes have been delivered at
formations of three mechanised brigades, two assault brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 1,560 troops, 19 armoured fighting vehicles, 130 motor vehicles, 12 field artillery guns, and seven electronic warfare stations in this direction.
🚩
Last week, the Yuzhnaya Group's units improved the situation along the front line and liberated Alekseyevo-Druzhkovka in the Donetsk People's Republic.
💥
Manpower and hardware of
four mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one mountain assault brigade, two airmobile brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade
have been hit.
▪️
In total, the enemy has lost more than 1,275 troops, 16 armoured fighting vehicles, 221 motor vehicles, 10 field artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations in the area of responsibility of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
